lemmas.name: constant_rank_kernel_determinant
premises: continuous complex skew family in a fixed finite-dimensional space
lemmas.conclusion: The quotient symplectic top form and fixed ambient volume trivialize the kernel determinant line, including nonsmooth bases.

lemmas.name: pfaffian_volume_transition
lemmas.conclusion: sigma_I=sign(I,J)/Pf(K_I), det(T_target_source)=sigma_source/sigma_target; positive-rank normalized frames have determinant-one transitions.

lemmas.name: complementary_pfaffian_section
lemmas.conclusion: Order-r complementary Pfaffians give a nonzero decomposable section of det(ker K) on rank r and vanish on every lower-rank locus.

lemmas.name: annihilator_orientation_and_first_chern
lemmas.conclusion: Real kernel transitions have positive determinant; the complex kernel has zero first integral Chern class.
